entries.title: Joshua 18:1
segments: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there: and the land was subdued before them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:2
segments: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

entries.title: Joshua 18:3
segments: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go in to possess the land, which Jehovah, the God of your fathers, hath given you?

entries.title: Joshua 18:4
segments: Appoint for you three men of each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall arise, and walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come unto me.

entries.title: Joshua 18:5
segments: And they shall divide it into seven portions: Judah shall abide in his border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their border on the north.

entries.title: Joshua 18:6
segments: And ye shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring [the description] hither to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah our God.

entries.title: Joshua 18:7
segments: For the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Jehovah is their inheritance: and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of Jehovah gave them.

entries.title: Joshua 18:8
segments: And the men arose, and went: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah in Shiloh.

entries.title: Joshua 18:9
segments: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven portions in a book; and they came to Joshua unto the camp at Shiloh.

entries.title: Joshua 18:10
segments: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Jehovah: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

entries.title: Joshua 18:11
segments: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

entries.title: Joshua 18:12
segments: And their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill-country westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

entries.title: Joshua 18:13
segments: And the border passed along from thence to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beth-el), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain that lieth on the south of Beth-horon the nether.

entries.title: Joshua 18:14
segments: And the border extended [thence], and turned about on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kiriath-baal (the same is Kiriath-jearim), a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

entries.title: Joshua 18:15
segments: And the south quarter was from the uttermost part of Kiriath-jearim; and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah;

entries.title: Joshua 18:16
segments: and the border went down to the uttermost part of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the vale of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel;

entries.title: Joshua 18:17
segments: and it extended northward, and went out at En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim; and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;

entries.title: Joshua 18:18
segments: and it passed along to the side over against the Arabah northward, and went down unto the Arabah;

entries.title: Joshua 18:19
segments: and the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the goings out of the border were at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan: this was the south border.

entries.title: Joshua 18:20
segments: And the Jordan was the border of it on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders thereof round about, according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 18:21
segments: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz,

entries.title: Joshua 18:22
segments: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

entries.title: Joshua 18:23
segments: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:24
segments: and Chephar-ammoni, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:

entries.title: Joshua 18:25
segments: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

entries.title: Joshua 18:26
segments: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:27
segments: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

entries.title: Joshua 18:28
segments: and Zelah, Eleph, and the Jebusite (the same is Jerusalem), Gibeath, [and] Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
